name: Greenely hourly usage · 18 October 2026
timestampBasis: Local Stockholm hour starts; repeated autumn hour mapped in chronological source order. Spring skipped hour maps continuously in UTC. Invoice reconciliation supports this interpretation, but source has no explicit offset.
missingPolicy: Original rows preserve blanks. Reference rows fill 48 hours using user-authorized historical profiles reconciled to the November invoice. Estimated rows retain provenance.
